scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,desktop "npm run dev -w @fabrica/ui" "npm run dev -w @fabrica/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n engine,ui "npm run dev:standalone -w @fabrica/engine" "npm run dev -w @fabrica/ui"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fabrica/ui && npm run build -w @fabrica/desktop
